title: Icahn Bails on JetBlue, Everyone's Cutting Routes, and Your Engine Oil Might Be Lying to You
summary: Carl Icahn dumps his entire JetBlue stake at a loss after his board seats went up in smoke — so was this activist investing or just a really expensive shrug? Plus, Allegiant, Alaska, Frontier, and WestJet all take a hatchet to their fall schedules on the same day, a flight attendant union sounds the alarm on engine oil designed to NOT smell bad, and a Delta flight strands its own passengers after a TSA checkpoint closes for the night.
